posts.title: Non-Gaussian Magic
posts.description: A notion of magic invariant under Gaussian rotations, with two tests suggesting SYK-4 has high non-Gaussian magic.

posts.title: Random Couplings and Ensembles of Operators
posts.description: A single chaotic SYK Hamiltonian carries its own ensemble of heavy operators: averaging fixed-weight Majorana strings reproduces the low-moment statistics of random couplings.

posts.title: A Toy Model of Wormholes
posts.description: A quantum anharmonic oscillator as a toy model for the competition between connected (wormhole) and disconnected saddles in the gravitational path integral.
